subject: Analysis engine terminated unexpectedly for HN Cos but not HR Simple in MCDS

messages.author: 3803273dbdab60c6
messages.subject: Analysis engine terminated unexpectedly for HN Cos but not HR Simple in MCDS
parts:
I am trying to run MCDS analyses to estimate distance using three covariates (one at a time).
I want to run each with both of the available key functions and common adjustments (Half Normal, with cosine and Hazard Rate, with simple poly).
The models run when I use the Hazard Rate function not when I run the Half Normal function.
All of the Half Normal models kick out this error: ** Error: Analysis engine terminated unexpectedly (with error code -2147483583).  **


Here's the log of one of the models that give this error (i.e., covariate = shrub cover). Anyone have thoughts on why I get this for HN models but not HR models? Is there anything I can do about it?

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Analysis engine terminated unexpectedly for HN Cos but not HR Simple in MCDS
parts:
Be very careful using covariates in addition to adjustment terms.  Combining both adjustments and covariates can lead to difficulties in model fitting, and convergence problems that might cause these termination errors.

My suspicion about why this happens with the half normal and not with the hazard rate could be that the half normal is trying to bring in adjustment terms when the hazard rate is not; leading to the clash.

Carefully read Chapter 10 of the users guide, specifically the section I highlight below:
